parameters.description_en: Optional profile at this namespace; the known payload version is exactly 1.0.0-draft.1.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description_ja: このlibrary内で一意なtemplate ID。Core IDではない。
parameters.description_en: Template ID unique within this library, not a Core ID.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description_ja: 正の反復周期tick。ノートのゲートを切らない。
parameters.description_en: Positive repeat period in ticks; does not truncate note gates.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description_ja: 開始位置順の具体的ノート配列。同時刻では配列順を保持。
parameters.description_en: Concrete notes in nondecreasing onset order; retain array order at equal starts.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description_ja: 表示名。IDの代用にはしない。
parameters.description_en: Display name; not a substitute for identity.

parameters.name: templateNoteId
parameters.description_ja: 参照template内のsource note ID。
parameters.description_en: Source-note ID local to the referenced template.

parameters.name: repeatIndex
parameters.description_ja: 0始まりの反復番号。current時はrepeatCount未満。
parameters.description_en: Zero-based repetition index; below repeatCount for current data.

parameters.name: noteId
parameters.description_ja: 対応先CoreノートのID。
parameters.description_en: Target Core note ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description_ja: このlibrary内で一意なinstance ID。
parameters.description_en: Instance ID unique within this library.

parameters.name: templateId
parameters.description_ja: 同じphrase-library内のtemplate ID。Core IDではない。
parameters.description_en: Template ID within this phrase library, not a Core ID.

parameters.name: clipId
parameters.description_ja: 対応するCore clipのID。
parameters.description_en: ID of the corresponding Core clip.

parameters.name: repeatCount
parameters.description_ja: 有限の反復回数。空templateでも正整数。
parameters.description_en: Finite repeat count, positive even for an empty template.

parameters.name: transpose
parameters.description_ja: 有音高ノートの半音移調量。打楽器slotは変更しない。
parameters.description_en: Semitone transposition for pitched notes; percussion slots are unchanged.

parameters.name: noteMap
parameters.description_ja: 全source note×反復と全clip noteを一対一に結ぶ対応。
parameters.description_en: Complete one-to-one mapping of source-note/repetition occurrences and clip notes.

parameters.name: templates
parameters.description_ja: 再利用する具体的phrase配列。
parameters.description_en: Reusable concrete phrase templates.

parameters.name: instances
parameters.description_ja: 実体化済みCore clipsへの対応配列。
parameters.description_en: Correspondences to already realized Core clips.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description_ja: 所属group内で一意なcandidate ID。
parameters.description_en: Candidate ID unique within its group.

parameters.name: clipIds
parameters.description_ja: 候補が使う重複なしCore clip ID列。空候補も許す。
parameters.description_en: Duplicate-free Core clip IDs used by the candidate; an empty candidate is allowed.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description_ja: 表示名。IDの代用にはしない。
parameters.description_en: Display name; not a substitute for identity.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description_ja: このclip-choices内で一意なgroup ID。
parameters.description_en: Group ID unique within this clip-choices extension.

parameters.name: candidates
parameters.description_ja: 1件以上の候補。
parameters.description_en: One or more candidates.

parameters.name: selectedCandidateId
parameters.description_ja: 選択した局所candidate ID、または未選択を表すnull。省略不可。
parameters.description_en: Selected local candidate ID, or null for no selection; the member is required.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description_ja: 表示名。IDの代用にはしない。
parameters.description_en: Display name; not a substitute for identity.

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description_ja: 選択グループ配列。別group間のclip管理範囲は重ねない。
parameters.description_en: Choice groups; managed clip sets do not overlap across groups.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description_ja: 形式識別子。正確にOSTF。
parameters.description_en: Exact format identifier OSTF.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description_ja: Core wire版。正確に3.0.0。
parameters.description_en: Exact Core wire version 3.0.0.

parameters.name: ppq
parameters.description_ja: 四分音符あたりの整数tick数。推奨960だが宣言値を使用する。
parameters.description_en: Integer ticks per quarter note; 960 is recommended but the declared value governs.

parameters.name: song
parameters.description_ja: 曲情報。
parameters.description_en: Song metadata.

parameters.name: timeline
parameters.description_ja: セクション・テンポ・拍子。
parameters.description_en: Sections, tempo and meter maps.

parameters.name: harmony
parameters.description_ja: 和音・音階の意味情報。
parameters.description_en: Chord and scale meaning.

parameters.name: tracks
parameters.description_ja: 表示順を保持する演奏トラック配列。
parameters.description_en: Performance tracks; preserve display order.

parameters.name: soundSlots
parameters.description_ja: 打楽器の発音先一覧。
parameters.description_en: Percussion-target definitions.

parameters.name: lyrics
parameters.description_ja: 歌詞とノートへの対応。
parameters.description_en: Lyrics and their note alignments.

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description_ja: 参照素材の一覧。自動取得しない。
parameters.description_en: Referenced source material; never fetched automatically.

parameters.name: extensions
parameters.description_ja: 標準profileと独自データのnamespace辞書。
parameters.description_en: Namespace dictionary of standard profiles and vendor data.

definitions.name: id
definitions.description_ja: IDの字句形式。Core全体での一意性と、profile内の局所IDの一意性は別の意味規則。
definitions.description_en: ID lexical form; Core-wide and profile-local uniqueness are separate semantic rules.

definitions.name: nonnegative
definitions.description_ja: 非負の整数tick・回数添字。
definitions.description_en: Nonnegative integer ticks or occurrence indices.

definitions.name: positive
definitions.description_ja: 正の整数tick・回数。
definitions.description_en: Positive integer ticks or counts.

definitions.name: signed
definitions.description_ja: 符号付き整数。ノートの局所開始位置に使用。
definitions.description_en: Signed integer, used for note-local start positions.

definitions.name: pitch
definitions.description_ja: 半音単位の音高番号。60=C4、69=A4。
definitions.description_en: Semitone pitch number; 60 is C4 and 69 is A4.

definitions.name: ref
definitions.description_ja: Coreオブジェクトへの型付き参照。typeとidの両方が一致する必要がある。
definitions.description_en: Typed Core reference; both kind and ID must match.

definitions.name: range
definitions.description_ja: 曲全体のtick座標による区間。終了位置の加算にも上限を適用する。
definitions.description_en: Range on the global tick timeline; the computed endpoint is also bounded.

definitions.name: spelledPitchClass
definitions.description_ja: 綴りを持つ音名。オクターブを含まず、異名同音の綴りを保持する。
definitions.description_en: Spelled pitch class without octave; enharmonic spelling is retained.

definitions.name: song
definitions.description_ja: 曲名と主旋律の指定。未命名の曲には空のtitleを使用できる。
definitions.description_en: Song title and primary-melody designation; an unnamed song may have an empty title.

definitions.name: section
definitions.description_ja: 曲構成の区間。隙間は許すが区間同士は重ならない。
definitions.description_en: Song-structure section; gaps are allowed but sections do not overlap.

definitions.name: tempo
definitions.description_ja: そのtick以後のテンポ。BPMは拍子によらず四分音符毎分。
definitions.description_en: Tempo from this tick onward, always measured in quarter notes per minute.

definitions.name: meter
definitions.description_ja: そのtick以後の拍子。変更点を暗黙の小節境界へ移動しない。
definitions.description_en: Meter from this tick onward; a reader does not move it to an inferred bar boundary.

definitions.name: timeline
definitions.description_ja: 曲構成、テンポ変更、拍子変更の配列。
definitions.description_en: Section, tempo-change and meter-change arrays.

definitions.name: chord
definitions.description_ja: 和音の意味情報。labelだけでも有効で、演奏ボイシングを生成しない。
definitions.description_en: Harmonic meaning; a label-only chord is allowed and does not generate a performed voicing.

definitions.name: scale
definitions.description_ja: 音階の意味情報。Coreノートの使用可能音を制限しない。
definitions.description_en: Scale meaning; it does not restrict the pitches permitted in Core notes.

definitions.name: harmony
definitions.description_ja: 和音と音階の配列。演奏はCoreノートとして別に保存する。
definitions.description_en: Chord and scale arrays; adopted performances are stored separately as Core notes.

definitions.name: instrument
definitions.description_ja: 楽器の表示情報。プラグイン状態や音源を指定する契約ではない。
definitions.description_en: Instrument description, not a plug-in-state or sound-engine contract.

definitions.name: note
definitions.description_ja: 発音対象、局所開始位置、ゲート長。Coreとphrase templateで同じ構造を使うがID範囲は異なる。
definitions.description_en: Target, local onset and gate duration; Core and phrase templates share this shape but have different ID scopes.

definitions.name: clip
definitions.description_ja: トラック上の配置・編集単位。durationはノートを切るマスクではない。
definitions.description_en: Placement/editing unit within a track; duration does not truncate its notes.

definitions.name: track
definitions.description_ja: 名前、役割、楽器説明、クリップを持つ演奏パート。配列順は表示順。
definitions.description_en: Performance part with name, role, instrument description and clips; array order is display order.

definitions.name: soundSlot
definitions.description_ja: 打楽器の発音先。IDが同一性を持ち、MIDI番号やroleは同一性ではない。
definitions.description_en: Percussion target; its ID establishes identity, not its MIDI hint or role.

definitions.name: lyricDocument
definitions.description_ja: 歌詞文書の識別と補助情報。
definitions.description_en: Lyric-document identity and auxiliary metadata.

definitions.name: lyricPhrase
definitions.description_ja: 表示用の歌詞フレーズ。分割単位の連結と同じ文字列である必要はない。
definitions.description_en: Displayed lyric phrase; it need not equal the concatenation of its units.

definitions.name: lyricUnit
definitions.description_ja: 歌詞の分割・対応づけの単位。
definitions.description_en: Lyric unit used for segmentation and note alignment.

definitions.name: lyricAlignment
definitions.description_ja: 歌詞単位とCoreノートの順序付き多対多対応。
definitions.description_en: Ordered many-to-many association between lyric units and Core notes.

definitions.name: lyrics
definitions.description_ja: 歌詞文書、フレーズ、単位、対応の四配列。
definitions.description_en: Four arrays for lyric documents, phrases, units and alignments.

definitions.name: sha256
definitions.description_ja: 小文字16進数64桁のSHA-256値。
definitions.description_en: SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

definitions.name: resource
definitions.description_ja: 生成素材などへの参照。読込時の取得・実行・音声再生指示ではない。
definitions.description_en: Reference to source material; loading does not fetch, execute or play it.

definitions.name: dependencies
definitions.description_ja: 拡張が依存するCoreの範囲。二つのoneOf構造で三種類のscopeを表す。
definitions.description_en: Core dependency scope; two oneOf shapes represent three scope values.

definitions.name: extension
definitions.description_ja: 既知・未知のすべての拡張に共通する閉じたenvelope。
definitions.description_en: Closed common envelope for every known or unknown extension.

definitions.name: relativeAssignment
definitions.description_ja: Coreの有音高ノートと、和音・音階の構成音との対応。
definitions.description_en: Relationship between one pitched Core note and a chord or scale interval.

definitions.name: relativeData
definitions.description_ja: 相対音高の対応一覧。読込時にCoreを書き換えない。
definitions.description_en: Relative-pitch assignments; they do not rewrite Core on load.

definitions.name: generator
definitions.description_ja: 生成器の識別子と版。アルゴリズムの再現を保証するものではない。
definitions.description_en: Generator identifier and version; not a guarantee of algorithm reproduction.

definitions.name: generationInput
definitions.description_ja: 一つの入力役割、Core参照、任意の読取範囲。
definitions.description_en: One input role, Core reference and optional context-read range.

definitions.name: generationProcess
definitions.description_ja: 生成入力・出力・保護ノートなどの関係記録。
definitions.description_en: Record of generation inputs, outputs and protected-note relationships.

definitions.name: generationData
definitions.description_ja: 複数の生成工程の記録。
definitions.description_en: Records of generation processes.

definitions.name: color
definitions.description_ja: RGB色。#に続く大文字または小文字の16進数6桁。
definitions.description_en: RGB color: # followed by six uppercase or lowercase hexadecimal digits.

definitions.name: roleDefinition
definitions.description_ja: 表示用の独自セクション役割の定義。
definitions.description_en: Custom section-role definition for presentation.

definitions.name: roleColorMap
definitions.description_ja: 任意のrole文字列からRGB色への辞書。
definitions.description_en: Dictionary from open role strings to RGB colors.

definitions.name: customRoleColorMap
definitions.description_ja: 定義済み独自role IDからRGB色への辞書。
definitions.description_en: Dictionary from declared custom-role IDs to RGB colors.

definitions.name: objectColor
definitions.description_ja: 型付きCore参照に対する個別色。
definitions.description_en: Object-specific color for a typed Core reference.

definitions.name: appearanceData
definitions.description_ja: 独自役割、セクションへの割当、色の表示情報。演奏には影響しない。
definitions.description_en: Custom roles, section assignments and presentation colors; no performance effect.

definitions.name: legacyData
definitions.description_ja: 2.3原文とSHA-256、移行記録の保存。Coreを書き戻す指示ではない。
definitions.description_en: Archive of 2.3 source text, its SHA-256 and a conversion report; not a command to restore Core.

definitions.name: extensions
definitions.description_ja: namespaceをキーに持つ拡張辞書。正確なnamespaceと版でpayload構造を選ぶ。
definitions.description_en: Namespace-keyed extension dictionary; exact namespace and version select the payload structure.

definitions.name: phraseTemplate
definitions.description_ja: 再利用する具体的ノート列。durationは反復周期。
definitions.description_en: Reusable concrete source notes; duration is the repeat period.

definitions.name: phraseNoteMapping
definitions.description_ja: source noteと反復番号から、実体化済みCoreノートへの対応。
definitions.description_en: Mapping from source-note identity and repetition index to a realized Core note.

definitions.name: phraseInstance
definitions.description_ja: templateと一つのCore clipの完全対応。
definitions.description_en: Complete correspondence between a template and one Core clip.

definitions.name: phraseLibraryData
definitions.description_ja: 具体的phrase templatesと実体化済みinstances。読込時に展開しない。
definitions.description_en: Concrete phrase templates and already realized instances; never expanded on load.

definitions.name: clipCandidate
definitions.description_ja: 候補の局所IDと、その候補で有効にするCore clips。
definitions.description_en: Candidate-local identity and the Core clips enabled for that choice.

definitions.name: clipChoiceGroup
definitions.description_ja: 候補群と保存済み選択。Coreのenabled状態との一致を記録する。
definitions.description_en: Candidate group and saved selection, corresponding to stored Core enabled states.

definitions.name: clipChoicesData
definitions.description_ja: 独立したクリップ選択グループの配列。
definitions.description_en: Array of independent clip-choice groups.

schema.title: Open Song Timeline Format 3.0.0
schema.description: Structural schema. Separate strict-wire, identity, time, reference and profile-semantic checks are mandatory for full conformance.
schema.$comment: Structural schema for OSTF 3.0.0. Profile versions remain provisional 1.0.0-draft.1. Strict-wire and semantic checks are defined in the specification and supplied validator. Integer token form requires strict-wire validation. Default annotations do not mutate data. Unknown profile versions use only the common extension envelope. Phrase and clip-choice payloads never execute on load.
